question: Should the recent Gateway lifecycle owner approve this single-registry consolidation for merge after the contributor adds real runtime proof?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but the protected `maintainer` label explicitly reserves ownership handling; automation cannot substitute for owner acceptance of this central lifecycle refactor.

options.title: Approve after live proof
options.body: Retain the unified registry and merge after redacted real Gateway evidence confirms terminal completion and timeout behavior.

options.title: Request narrower ownership scope
options.body: Ask the contributor to split or reduce the consolidation if dedupe ingestion or cache ownership needs separate review.

recommendation.title: Approve after live proof
recommendation.body: Retain the unified registry and merge after redacted real Gateway evidence confirms terminal completion and timeout behavior.
